items.title: TPR Q2 Deep Dive: International Growth and Marketing Investments Shape Mixed Outlook
items.summary: Luxury fashion conglomerate Tapestry (NYSE:TPR) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8.9% year on year to $1.88 billion. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $8.45 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.32 per share was 3.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
